text: A female figure with long black hair, pale skin, and a slender build wears a purple gown with high slits and holds ropes. Her face is oval, with dark eyes, red lips, and dangling earrings. She stands in profile, facing right, revealing the gown’s cut and her footwear. Other panels show frontal, three-quarter, and rear views of the same figure. Circular insets detail eye color, lip shape, ear, fabric texture, and a black circle.
